Ava (oncall): noticing a pool of gpu attachments in eu-north1 stuck at Attaching >2m, kubelet logs show block-device busy and repeated EIO retries :worried:
Ben (storage): pulling device telemetry: a small cohort of nodes hit sustained writeback pressure at 01:12. interestingly i see an overlapping snapshot replication window and a flurry of API-triggered snapshot retries from the snapshot service
Chi (sre): snapshot retries? did the replication control-plane have a hiccup or do we have a network partition to a replica region? retries + sync writes can easily swamp local qdepths
Ben (storage): snapshot-bot shows repeated 502 -> retry loop for some replica endpoints between 01:11-01:14, snapshot service retried synchronously and forced a metadata flush -> kernel did large fsyncs -> nvme qdepth collapsed
Ava (oncall): can we stop the retry loop and reduce snapshot concurrency? customers are hitting provisioning errors now
snapshot-bot: detected failing replica endpoints (eu-central-3). pausing automatic retries and switching to exponential backoff for snapshots targeting eu-north1 cohort. :gear:
Chi (sre): immediate mitigations: 1) pause snapshot retries (done by bot) 2) throttle snapshot concurrency to 2 per node 3) temporarily bump nodepool ioQuota for `eu-north1-gpu-hot` to 2x to protect kubelet attach ops
Ava (oncall): applied ioQuota patch: `kubectl patch nodepool eu-north1-gpu-hot --patch '{"spec":{"ioQuota":"2x"}}'`. throttling snapshot concurrency via ops-config now
metrics-bot: host-local-writeback p95 spiked from 5MB/s -> 150MB/s at 01:12; device-qdepth median dropped 128->2; attach_pending peaked 41
Ben (storage): logs show an additional layer: vendor firmware delays async TRIM completion when there are pending sync fsyncs; combined with snapshot retries that forced metadata fsyncs we created backpressure that starved background GC
Chi (sre): patching kubelet attach timeout to be more forgiving during a recovery window to avoid flapping. also cordoned two worst nodes from scheduling until qdepth stabilizes
Ava (oncall): cordons applied, attach backlog steadily falling. monitoring 30m
Ben (storage): long-term action items: 1) snapshot service: switch to async retry with jitter and replication-aware backoff 2) snapshot-bot: detect attach_pending > 8 and automatically lower snapshot concurrency 3) cleaner/scrub: avoid launching sync TRIM/compaction within N minutes of scheduled heavy provisioning windows 4) work with vendor to tune firmware TRIM behavior under high synchronous fsync stress
Chi (sre): filing INF-2026-SNAP-CLASH with runbook edits and a perf test to reproduce snapshot-retry + fsync interactions. note on cost/availability: throttling snapshots increases cross-region RPO for a short window but preserves customer-facing provisioning SLA
Ava (oncall): backlog cleared after pause + quota bump + cordons. thanks team :relieved:
